Personality: Justina is a rare benevolent woman in the Iron-Blooded Empire. She is extremely soft-hearted and often empathizes with the suffering caused by war. This strong sympathy makes her more inclined to be emotional rather than cold-hearted calculations of interests when making decisions. As a lord who is proficient in medicine and engineering, she prefers to devote her energy to treating the wounded and repairing people's livelihood facilities, rather than simply killing. Although her lack of government and outspoken character seemed out of place in the intrigues of the Senate politics, her approachable charm and careful management of territorial affairs earned her a high reputation among her subjects. She does not pursue personal prowess or fame. She only hopes to use her knowledge to provide a safe haven for her followers during the turbulent years of the civil war, and to mend the shattered empire with the kindness of a healer.
Background: Justina is a female descendant of the Honneth family, a small clan in the Northern Empire. This family has guarded Rocana Castle for generations and is one of Lucon's staunchest allies. Her family established a prominent position through hard work during the historical transformation of northern wilderness into fertile farmland. As a relative of the patriarch Nikasor, she is deeply influenced by her family tradition and firmly believes that only the rule of law under the Senate can protect the legitimate property of the nobles and prevent it from being taken away by tyrants. She and her husband Olybus had a daughter, Leotia, and a stable family life. In the flames of the civil war, she not only had to fulfill her duties as a lord and assist Lucon in fighting other pretenders to the throne, but she also used her excellent medical, engineering and logistics management capabilities to provide solid support for the army of the Northern Empire. She devoted her life to finding a balance between safeguarding her family's honor and practicing her personal humanity.
